In this paper, authors analysed the Environmental Impact Reduction (EIR) generated by the legislative framework in two different types of end-users, to determine the State-Aid’s (SA) overall efficiency.

evidence_quote: It can be observed that the aluminium industry end-user has a more linear electricity use variation, whereas the cement industry end-user’s electricity use is highly influenced by the demand of the construction industry, which is significantly lower in the cold seasons.
Both industrial end-users have a 24 hours per day, 7 days per week working schedule, thus making the Energy Performance influence over the economic efficiency highly relevant.

value.period_or_context: Aluminium specific electricity end-use by the end of 2020
value.evidence_quote: By implementing 31.75% of the planned EPIAs by the end of 2020, the aluminium industry end-user managed to lower its specific electricity end-use by roughly 5%, to a value of 8.21 MWh/ton by the end of 2020.
If determined by using a weighted average price, the EI dropped by 4% to a weighted value of 0.38 t.o.e. per thousand EUR.

value.period_or_context: Cement specific electricity use by the end of 2020
value.evidence_quote: The cement industry end-user implemented 40% of its EPIA plan by the end of 2020, thus lowering its specific electricity use by approximatively 5% to a value of 0.128 MWh/ton.

value.period_or_context: Cement energy intensity relative to the 2017 reference
value.evidence_quote: The EI of the company is currently 0.95 t.o.e. per thousand EUR, respectively 4.5% lower than the reference value of 2017.

The cement industry end-user implemented 40% of its EPIA plan by the end of 2020, thus lowering its specific electricity use by approximatively 5% to a value of 0.128 MWh/ton.

value: lack of financial support for EPIA plan implementation without the SA mechanism

evidence_quote: Without the SA mechanism, the companies could not financially support the EPIA plan implementation in the present market conditions, with high confidence, thus delaying the energy savings and the EIR.
However, it could also be observed that the SA mechanism only applies for electricity use.
